name: @gltf-studio/agent-mock
description: MockAgentProvider: the v1 mock/offline AgentService implementation (specs/agent-service.md AG-010, docs/adr/0004-agentic-authoring-as-command-producer.md). Recognizes a small set of prompt templates (spin/rotate, move, play-sound-on-click, add-cube) and builds Proposals exclusively via editor-core's GraphEdit/SceneEdit command factories, validated via @gltfi/ir + @gltfi/verify before being returned.
